scope: CVG-004 scheduled-report delivery persistence lease fencing

criteria.description: Fresh local residual reconciliation identified that the scheduled worker claims a schedule lease but calls delivery persistence without carrying that schedule token; the existing claimToken parameter belongs to failed-delivery retry leases.
criteria.limitations: Two replacement scouts were unavailable because of the auxiliary model usage limit; selection is direct source/test reconciliation, not independent approval.

criteria.description: The current ReportsService has separate schedule and delivery claim maps and the database schema already persists both schedule claims and delivery rows, so a repository-local conditional delivery write can be added without changing report payloads or retry claims.
criteria.limitations: Source inspection identifies the missing fence; PostgreSQL behavior remains unverified until the RED/GREEN integration proof.

criteria.description: The bounded correction can be tested as a separate scheduleClaimToken capability, fail closed for stale durable writes, preserve active-token delivery, and retain external provider side effects and lease renewal as explicit non-claims.
criteria.limitations: Intentional RED/GREEN, PostgreSQL proof, regression, quality, review and final reconciliation remain open.

gaps: Implementation, intentional RED/GREEN, PostgreSQL takeover proof, regression, quality and review evidence remain open.
Provider/export/audit external side effects, delivery retry claims, heartbeat/renewal and distributed worker topology remain outside scope.
Parent CVG-004, global Vetus/clinical parity, target, production, provider and release gates remain open.
conditions: Use a distinct scheduleClaimToken capability; do not reinterpret the existing failed-delivery claimToken.
Require account, schedule, active claim token and active lease for schedule-worker delivery persistence; no saveDelivery fallback when a schedule token is supplied.
Keep provider calls and external side-effect guarantees out of this bounded gate and document any in-flight side-effect limitation.
Keep parent CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation and direct read-only residual reconciliation
authority.scope: Repository-local scheduled-report delivery persistence fence, ReportsService capability separation, worker propagation and disposable PostgreSQL takeover tests
authority.decision: Authorize only the additive scheduleClaimToken delivery-persistence fence and worker ordering correction. Preserve existing report payloads, provider adapter, delivery retry claims and API compatibility; exclude provider behavior, renewal, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing provider invocation semantics, delivery retry claims, report payloads, schedule API client contracts, lease renewal, migration shape beyond the repository contract, or entering target/production/deployment/release scope.

next_action: Focused GREEN and PostgreSQL takeover passed. Run full workspace regression, coverage, static security/contract checks and bounded review; keep provider side effects and global promotion open.
